Universal Ongoing Requirements
Mandatory milestones required for every graduate degree program.
By 2nd Semester
Appointment of Advisory Committee
Establish your institutional advising team. This form officially solidifies your panel
of mentors and anchors your graduation path tracking.
Due Annually
Annual Academic Progress Report (AAPR)
Required by April 15th each year. Documents milestones, narrative self-evaluations, and committee ratings
to verify program standing.
